notes.title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite – Hotfix #2 is now live!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/deccd3a85dbaf0fe99a2b15b00bf0772d4d8d1b5.png"]Attention, Firefighters!


The fire never sleeps — and neither do we!
Hot on the heels of our first update, Hotfix #2 has rushed to the scene to tackle even more issues you’ve reported.

This update includes several fixes and improvements to keep your firefighting experience running smoothly.


Changelog – Hotfix #2
Fixed several translation issues

Fixed crash when joining the same multiplayer lobby more then once

Improved AI Firetruck Navigation

Fixed an issue in the vehicle selection for Mission "Just Tuning The Engine"

Fixed an issue in the Mission "Stuck at the Office" which prevent some areas from being extinguished

Improved general game stability



Thank you for all your feedback and reports — you’re helping us make Firefighting Simulator: Ignite the best it can be!



Stay safe out there,

Your Firefighting Simulator Team 🧑‍🚒

notes.title: The First Modding Missions are here!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/82b79e011d850ad76e0022ffeaad49e723ec329b.png"]Attention, Firefighters!
We’re excited to announce that the very first mods for Firefighting Simulator: Ignite are here!

Since the Release last week, our amazing community has already created over 50+ mods (okay, some of them might have been created by our devs, but Shhh..!). We’re blown away by everyone’s creativity and passion. 🙌 15 of these mods are also already available on consoles, bringing new missions and experiences to players everywhere.

Check out the mods here: https://mod.io/g/ffsignite



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/55f570e810f02d976584d4794dd3c1e0072f39e4.png"]
❤️ A Huge Thank You to Our Community.
We want to give a massive thank you to every creator and player who has jumped into the world of modding. Your creations and your dedication are helping to make Firefighting Simulator: Ignite even more exciting and dynamic.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/7ba66c9f7667de7c8ab9b6925cc81b4970847c63.png"]
🕒 Why Mods take a bit longer on Consoles.
To ensure mods on consoles are safe, stable, and fun, each one must be manually checked and approved before it goes live.

Because of this, there will always be a slight delay between when a mod appears on PC and when it becomes available on consoles. Our team is carefully reviewing each mod step by step, so if you don’t see a particular mod on console right away, rest assured – as long as it doesn't cause any trouble or violates any rules, it’s on the way!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/620b35ca26903754e2d2e36a77a260226a50e44b.png"]
🎮 Start playing Community Missions now.
Head over to the Mods section in-game and check out the very first community-created missions – or jump in and create your own!

Once again, thank you for making this possible – we can’t wait to see what you’ll create next. 🔥


Stay safe out there,

Your Firefighting Simulator Team 🧑‍🚒

notes.title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite – Hotfix #1 is now live!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/f26aacab087348d7cb5a515fe922e3da5cfb75d1.png"]Attention, Firefighters!

As promised, our first hotfix for Firefighting Simulator: Ignite is now live!



Hotfix #1 addresses several issues that you have helped us identify over the past week. Here’s the full list of fixes and improvements:

 
Changelog – Hotfix #1
Fixed issue where conscious victims would not properly enter the aerial cage when following the player

Fixed input issues on vehicle interactions (Siren, Yelp) while driving

Fixed an area that was almost impossible to extinguish in the mission "The Kiosk"

Fixed holes in destroyed residential roofs: It is no longer possible to fall through and get stuck

Fixed several translation issues

Fixed issues with AI firetruck obstacle detection

Fixed a compression issue on Intel 13th and 14th gen. CPUs. This has sadly led to most content being compressed again inflating the patch file size. We are sorry for the inconvenience =(

Improved general game stability



We’re continuing to work hard on resolving other reported issues and improving your experience.

A huge thank you to every single one of you for playing, sharing feedback, reporting bugs, and helping us shape the future of Firefighting Simulator: Ignite.


You’re awesome! ❤️


Thank you for your patience and support as we keep making the game even better.


Stay safe out there,

Your Firefighting Simulator Team 🧑‍🚒

notes.title: Upcoming Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/7af657213dc1a2fddea7977511da1a09027bd930.png"]
Attention, Firefighters!

First off, a huge thank you to everyone for playing Firefighting Simulator: Ignite and sharing your feedback over the last few days. It's been incredible to see how you've been engaging with the game and helping us identify issues that need attention.

We're currently preparing to release a first hotfix early next week. Because this update needs to be coordinated across all platforms for crossplay, we don't have an exact timing for this.

The main focus of this hotfix is addressing as many crashes as possible.

Please note that the download size will be around 25GB, due to changes in compression.


Here is a tentative list of fixes:

Fixed issue where conscious victims would not properly enter the aerial cage when following the player

Fixed input issues on vehicle interactions (Siren, Yelp) while driving

Fixed an area that was almost impossible to extinguish in the mission "The Kiosk"

Fixed holes in destroyed residential roofs: It is no longer possible to fall through and get stuck

Fixed several translation issues

Fixed issues with AI firetruck obstacle detection

Fixed a compression issue on Intel 13th and 14th gen. CPUs. This has sadly led to most content being compressed again inflating the patch file size. We are sorry for the inconvenience =(

Improved general game stability




Known Issues & Workarounds


While we work on these fixes, here are some temporary solutions for common issues:


Extremely bright screen on PC: Try changing the Quality Preset in your graphics settings. You should be able to re-apply your original settings afterwards.

If you are experiencing crashes in the mission "Crashing the Party", try skipping the approach when starting the mission. This can help to avoid the crash.

Severe FPS drops when using foam with FSR Frame Generation enabled: Disable FSR Frame Generation in the graphics settings.

Crashes related to GPU drivers: It may help to launch the game with the following startup option: "-clearPSODriverCache". If your problem persists, remove this option again as it will slowdown the game start.


Thank you for your patience and continued support as we work to improve the gameplay experience!

Your Firefighting Simulator Team 🧑‍🚒

notes.title: Gear Up – Firefighting Simulator: Ignite is coming!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/07e288be8552ec9a9ad8a3df0cd1cff25552f514.jpg

Attention all heroes! 

We’re thrilled to announce Firefighting Simulator: Ignite, our  upcoming immersive firefighting experience. It’s time to gear up for the adrenaline-fueled world of firefighting – coming this Fall to Steam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/e7f6806b158137712436642d92ed175b5250ecb1.jpg

🔥United Against Fire. 

Face unpredictable dangers head-on, fight perilous fires with your crew, and save lives in Firefighting Simulator: Ignite. Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter in a sprawling city in the American Midwest, where every mission pushes your skills to the limit. 

Experience the rush of firefighting in stunning visual quality in an intuitive and cooperative multiplayer mode with 3 friends or with the help of your NPC crew members. Battle raging and dynamic flames, heat and smoke, all simulated in real-time with the cutting-edge physics and graphics systems powered by Unreal Engine 5 letting you immerse yourself in firefighting in a never-before-experienced way.

When the emergency call comes in, every second counts. Take the fastest route to the scene, gear up, and work together to fight fires and save lives. Are you ready to become a true hero?

Have a first look at Firefighting Simulator: Ignite in our announcement teaser:

[previewyoutube=GDJk8v2jaHc;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/2983950df912a841f02fa8b828de0d3fd2b5605c.jpg

🧯Gear up for your Shift.

With Firefighting Simulator: Ignite, we want to ignite your passion for the world of firefighting. Gear up for these core features:


Be an everyday hero: Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter
Ignite your passion: Fight perilous fires in single- and multiplayer mode
United against fire: Join forces with your friends in 4-player coop-mode or fill up your squad with NPC teammates 
Be quick to respond: Drive faithfully reproduced, licensed Rosenbauer America fire trucks, such as TP3® Pumper, Viper®, 68’ Roadrunner and more
Gear up: Use authentic equipment from leading US firefighting brands such as HAIX®, Fire-Dex, STIHL and Leatherhead Tools
Explore the fire station: Your hub for learning techniques and choosing your next emergency missions
Immerse yourself in the simulation: Experience a cutting-edge firefighting simulation with realistic fire, heat, water, and smoke simulation powered by Unreal Engine 5
Mod your own: Create mods and share them via Mod.io 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/d38c4657f8e3be3ee314dd03fdc1fe6a28226c41.jpg

🚒 Behind the Flames.

Firefighting Simulator: Ignite is published by astragon Entertainment, developed by weltenbauer. Software Entwicklung GmbH, and supported by the Federal Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate Action. The new game from the developers of the Construction Simulator franchise is powered by Unreal Engine 5 and will be available for $34.99 (or your regional equivalent) on Steam in Fall 2025. Firefighting Simulator: Ignite will launch on PC and consoles, with support for crossplay. Physical copies will be available in select countries.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/a6031e5f373c233bf14b559685b0a19ad4643841.jpg

🧑‍🚒 Join the Squad.

Want to join the squad? Be sure to wishlist Firefighting Simulator: Ignite on Steam and follow us on Social Media for the latest news, announcements, and behind-the-scenes content. Join the community on Discord to share your excitement with fellow firefighting fans and give us your feedback! We can’t wait to hear what you’re most looking forward to! 💌
